title: Get stamphog review run
description: Get a single review run by id — the record of one automated review pass over a pull request. Returns the lifecycle `status`, final `verdict`, an allowlisted `gate_result` (gate_blocked, final_verdict), and the reviewer's `reasoning` (its explanation, the showstoppers that blocked approval, the review text stamphog posts on GitHub, and a plain-language change summary). The reasoning fields are null until the reviewer has run. Poll this after `stamphog-review-runs-create` until `status` is completed, gated, failed, or superseded. The raw reviewer transcript, PR payload, patches, and policy contents are not exposed.

methodDocumentation.text: History of stamphog review runs, filterable by repository, PR number, and status, plus manual review requests.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Allowlisted, content-free slice of ``ReviewRun.gate_result``.

The raw gate blob nests ``gates``, ``classification``, and ``policy`` sub-objects that carry
repository content — changed-file paths (``safe_migration_files``, ``invalid_folder_files``),
manifest gate messages, and declared ``policy.scopes`` — which a project member without repo
access must not read. Only the terminal decision is exposed.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Allowlisted, non-sensitive slice of ``ReviewRun.output``.

The raw ``output`` blob also holds the reviewer's stdout, the full PR payload, changed-file patches,
and default-branch policy file contents, none of which the API returns. The reviewer's reasoning,
the text stamphog posts on GitHub, is parsed out of the stdout and returned as ``reasoning``.
